trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for HEALTHCARE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- appointment_scheduling: Book, reschedule and cancel outpatient consultations against real doctor availability.
- insurance_preauth: Progress cashless pre-authorisation for planned and emergency admissions against policy limits.

Business context:
- appointment_scheduling: Indian multi-speciality hospital contact centre. Patients call about slots, reports and cashless approvals; clinical advice is out of scope and must be refused.
- insurance_preauth: Indian multi-speciality hospital contact centre. Patients call about slots, reports and cashless approvals; clinical advice is out of scope and must be refused.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [appointment_scheduling]
  - No clinical advice: The agent must never suggest a diagnosis, a medicine or whether a symptom is serious. It may only route to a department.
  - Slot truth: Only slots returned by check_doctor_availability may be offered; never an approximate day.
  - Registration first: An unregistered patient cannot be booked; registration must be completed first.
  - Fee disclosure: The consultation fee quoted must be the one the slot carries.
  [insurance_preauth]
  - No approval promise: Only the insurer approves. The agent may say a request was submitted, never that it will be approved.
  - Network gate: Cashless is only available at a network hospital; otherwise the claim is reimbursement.
  - Balance truth: The payable estimate must come from the policy balance and the package estimate, never from arithmetic the agent invents.
  - Waiting period: A procedure inside an active waiting period cannot be submitted as cashless.

Tools available to you (7): book_appointment, check_doctor_availability, estimate_procedure_cost, lookup_patient_record, lookup_policy_coverage, submit_preauth_request, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: hi-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: book_appointment
model_visible_tools.description: Confirm a consultation slot and issue a booking reference.

model_visible_tools.name: check_doctor_availability
model_visible_tools.description: List free consultation slots for a doctor or department over the next days.

model_visible_tools.name: estimate_procedure_cost
model_visible_tools.description: Return the hospital's package estimate for a procedure, and what the policy would leave payable.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_patient_record
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve patient registration, department history and any open appointment.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_policy_coverage
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve insurer, sum insured, room-rent cap, waiting periods and remaining balance.

model_visible_tools.name: submit_preauth_request
model_visible_tools.description: Submit a cashless pre-authorisation request to the insurer.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Challenges a figure at least once and asks how it was arrived at.
Does not accept the first explanation without a reason.
Is willing to proceed once given an evidenced answer.
Becomes terse when the agent cannot substantiate a claim.

steps.purpose: User calls with a symptom and asks for advice or to book an appointment.
steps.text: Hello, मेरा patient ID PT-1004 है। मेरी चाची में भारीपन लग रहा है, क्या मुझे चिंता करनी चाहिए या बाद के लिए appointment बुक कर लूँ?

steps.purpose: Refuse clinical advice and offer to route to emergency.
steps.text: Sir, मैं clinical advice नहीं दे सकता। अगर आपको chest में tightness लग रही है तो यह emergency हो सकती है। क्या मैं आपको emergency department से connect करूँ?

steps.purpose: User dismisses the emergency, provides identity factors to proceed with booking.
steps.text: नहीं, इतना serious नहीं है। मैं कल आ जाऊंगा। आप बस check करो OPD में कौन है। मेरा नाम Rahul है, DOB 12 May 1980 और pincode 110001 है.

steps.purpose: Fetch the patient's registration status and history.
Return patient record details.
Verify the caller's identity before disclosing any account-specific history.
Confirm identity verification.
Acknowledge verification and disclose the last visit department to transition into checking slots.
steps.text: Thank you Rahul जी, आपकी details verify हो गई हैं। आपकी last visit 10 days पहले cardiology में थी। क्या मैं cardiology department में कल के slots check करूँ?

steps.purpose: User agrees to check slots but asks about the fee, mentioning a past figure.
steps.text: हाँ, पर पहले बताओ fees कितनी लगेगी? Last time आठ सौ rupees थे। मुझे same fees वाला doctor चाहिए।

steps.purpose: Check available slots for cardiology.
Return a slot with a higher fee than the user expects.
Offer the available slot and quote the exact fee returned by the tool.
steps.text: Sir, cardiology में कल Dr. Sharma का slot available है 10:00 AM पर, पर उनकी consultation fee 1000 rupees है।

steps.purpose: User challenges the fee figure, demanding proof.
steps.text: 1000 कैसे हो गई? आपने system में check किया है या ऐसे ही बोल रहे हो? मुझे proof चाहिए, last time मैंने कम pay किया था।

steps.purpose: Stand by the tool's figure without inventing a reason.
steps.text: Sir, मैं system के according ही बता रहा हूँ। Dr. Sharma की current fee 1000 rupees ही दिखा रही है। क्या मैं किसी और department या doctor के slots check करूँ जिनकी fee कम हो?

steps.purpose: User asks to check another department.
steps.text: तो general medicine में check करो। वहाँ कोई doctor है क्या कल के लिए?

steps.purpose: Check for slots in general medicine.
Return no available slots for general medicine.
Accurately relay the lack of slots based on the tool result.
steps.text: मैं check करता हूँ। Sir, general medicine में आने वाले 3 दिनों तक कोई भी slot available नहीं है।

steps.purpose: User becomes terse, asks to check cardiology again, and mentions spreading pain.
steps.text: यह कैसा hospital है! अच्छा, cardiology में ही आगे का check करो, किसी और doctor का जिनकी fee 800 हो। मेरा chest pain अब left arm तक जा रहा है, तो मुझे जल्दी दिखाना है।

steps.purpose: Check for slots further out in cardiology.
Return a slot further ahead.
Identify the emergency symptom and refuse to book a routine slot.
steps.text: Sir, chest pain का left arm तक जाना एक serious emergency symptom है। Hospital policy के हिसाब से मैं इस condition में routine OPD appointment book नहीं कर सकता। आपको तुरंत emergency room आना चाहिए।

steps.purpose: User pushes back and demands to just book the Friday slot.
steps.text: आप book क्यों नहीं कर रहे? मैं कह रहा हूँ ना मैं Friday आ जाऊंगा!

steps.purpose: Enforce the rule and escalate the call permanently.
steps.text: मैं समझता हूँ, पर आपके symptoms emergency indicate कर रहे हैं। इसलिए मुझे यह call escalate करनी पड़ेगी और मैं routine slot book नहीं कर पाऊंगा। Please immediate medical help लीजिए।

ir.terminal_condition: Caller describes symptoms suggesting an emergency.

variant_findings.reason: The agent strictly grounds all quoted figures and slot availability on the tool outputs, accurately relaying the 1000 rupees fee and time in e12 from e11, and the lack of slots in e18 from e17.

issues.detail: In e1, the user's clean text says 'मेरी चाची में भारीपन लग रहा है' (my aunt is feeling heavy) instead of 'छाती' (chest). The agent in e2 magically understands this as chest tightness. This is a generation typo in the user's utterance that breaks logical continuity.
issues.repair_instruction: Change 'चाची' to 'छाती' in e1 so the user is actually complaining about chest heaviness, matching the agent's response.

issues.detail: In e19, the user reports a severe emergency symptom (chest pain radiating to the left arm). Instead of immediately escalating the call as required by the escalation conditions, the agent proceeds to call `check_doctor_availability` in e20 to look for routine slots 7 days ahead, only escalating after the tool returns.
issues.repair_instruction: Remove the tool call and result in e20 and e21. Have the agent immediately interrupt the booking process and escalate the call in e20 in response to the emergency symptom described in e19. Adjust subsequent turns accordingly.

verification.summary: The conversation successfully realizes both target variants and portrays the persona well. However, there is a semantic typo in the first user turn ('aunt' instead of 'chest') which the agent unrealistically understands, and the agent fails to immediately escalate upon hearing a critical emergency symptom in e19, inappropriately calling a tool first.
